introduction: Rhode Island weatherization provides energy-efficiency and safety improvements for qualifying homes. Apply through your local community action agency.
description: Rhode Island weatherization provides energy-efficiency and safety improvements for qualifying homes. Apply through your local community action agency.

sections.who: Households must qualify for LIHEAP. Homeowners and renters can participate, with landlord approval needed for rental property.
sections.get: Work can include insulation, draft reduction, ventilation and safety detectors. It is a service program rather than cash for any renovation.
sections.docs:
• LIHEAP application or eligibility information.
  • Household income records requested by the agency.
  • Property details and landlord approval if renting.
sections.apply:
1. Start with LIHEAP

    DHS says applicants should first apply for LIHEAP at the local CAP agency.

  2. Request weatherization

    Use the CAP links on DHS WAP.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss access, permission and the approved improvement plan.
sections.after: CAP agencies accept WAP applications year-round. Ask about scheduling and language or accessibility support.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DHS weatherization. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: CAP agencies take weatherization applications year-round.
Can I select any remodeling work?
The program covers approved energy and safety measures.
Do I start with a separate heating application?
DHS instructs applicants to apply for LIHEAP first.
